label: Ford Transit 350 L3 H2 FWD · 제원 기반
derivation: Conservative envelope for the published 350 L3 H2 FWD diesel van range: 3500 kg gross minus 2190 kg kerb minus one 75 kg driver = 1235 kg cargo. Tare includes driver. Volume 11.5 m3, upper published height 2.530 m, width including mirrors 2.474 m. These values are not an exact configured or weighed vehicle and are not a humanitarian agency recommendation.
warehouse_reason: In the saved acquired geometry Lwowska 36 is shorter to Medyka (10.269 vs 13.124 km) and Korczowa (35.151 vs 37.239 km); Dorohusk is only 0.383 km longer. This is a geographic baseline, not proof of warehouse operation or capacity.
fleet_reason: One vehicle is the minimum dispatchable comparison baseline. It is not an estimate of the agency fleet or an optimal fleet size. Up to three vehicles are supported by this bounded UI scenario; the model can accept other explicit inputs separately.

scenario.path_policy: Shortest-distance feasible road path per vehicle; k=1. Detailed road JSON can use the full multi-candidate model.

scenario_note: Speed, handling, weekday duties, road access and depot/destination/intermediate rest are declared project assumptions. Intermediate rest nodes are road vertices, not verified rest facilities. Overnight fallback delivers within one duty and returns in the next after 11..36h rest. Cost is a net public van distance reference valued with dated NBP FX, plus optional user quote components. Missing cost components are excluded, not verified zero. Not certified operational readiness.

cost_reference.scope: Distance component only. Hour tariff is a separate basis, not automatically additive. Not an observed paid cost, quote, current tariff guarantee or all-in transport cost. Fixed/time/minimum/overnight defaults zero mean excluded pending quote, not free services.
